decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to efficiently use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play. The deck also contains disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces. Additionally, there are cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the necessary cards. The mana base includes dual lands like Underground Sea and fetch lands to help with consistency and fixing. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly and effectively bringing back intimidating threats from the graveyard.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a combo using Mystic Forge and various artifact cards like Glaring Fleshraker, Mox Opal, and Defense Grid. By utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Manifold Key, the deck aims to generate infinite mana and infinite creature tokens to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Candelabra of Tawnos and Urza's Tower helps to ramp up mana production while cards like Urza's Saga and The One Ring provide additional value and utility to the combo strategy.

The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays while utilizing a variety of spells to control the board. With a mix of creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, along with powerful instant spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will, the deck aims to maintain pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy. Utilizing cards like Wasteland and Daze to control the opponent's mana base, Canadian Threshold is a fast-paced aggro deck that relies on tempo and precision to secure victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

This Reanimator combo deck aims to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like Entomb, Animate Dead, and Reanimate. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to protect the combo and interact with the opponent's game plan. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and filtering, while cards like Brazen Borrower and Archon of Cruelty offer additional threats and utility. The deck's mana base is streamlined to support the combo strategy with fetch lands and dual lands for consistent mana development.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining a fast and aggressive pace. Utilizing powerful disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze, along with removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to control the board and tempo of the game. The deck also includes threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf, backed up by card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and card selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck rounds out its strategy with a few utility lands and creature options to provide additional pressure and control.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to use aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers alongside disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void to control the game and quickly overwhelm the opponent. With powerful artifacts like The One Ring and Sundering Eruption, along with ramp from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, this deck aims to lock down the opponent's options while dishing out heavy damage with dragons and other aggressive creatures. The mana base is built to support these strategies and enable quick plays to dominate the game.

This deck revolves around utilizing Mystic Forge and various artifacts to generate infinite mana and cast powerful spells like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Karn, the Great Creator. By combining the synergy between cards like Baslat Monolith, Grim Monolith, and Voltaic Key, the player can create an overwhelming board presence and lock down the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Candelabra of Tawnos and Ugin's Tower helps to further accelerate the mana generation, leading to explosive turns and eventual victory. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful spells.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also utilizes strong disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The key strategy is to efficiently control the game early on with disruptive spells, then quickly bring back powerful threats to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory. The deck aims to win through a fast and powerful reanimation combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing Nadu, Winged Wisdom as a key combo piece to generate card advantage and create a strong board presence. It aims to control the game with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, while also using cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Brainstorm to find key pieces for the combo. The deck also includes interactive elements such as Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt opponents' game plans. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces and outvaluing the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this Combo - Reanimator Legacy deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb. Then utilize cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to cheat these creatures into play, bypassing their mana cost. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Murktide Regent provide additional card advantage and threats to the opponent. This deck aims to win the game quickly through powerful reanimation combos.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier through cards like Entomb and Animate Dead, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Shallow Grave. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to control the opponent's hand. By utilizing fast mana sources like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, the deck aims to cheat out big threats early in the game to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive tactics and tempo plays to control the game and outpace the opponent. By running a mix of disruptive spells like Stifle and Daze, along with powerful creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card selection tools like Preordain and Ponder to ensure consistency and efficiency. With a balance of threats and disruption, the deck aims to establish dominance early on and maintain momentum throughout the game.

It also includes cards like Omniscience and Cunning Wish to further enhance the combo potential. The deck aims to quickly set up a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with its big creatures and control elements.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to play powerful dragons and other aggressive creatures. This is combined with disruptive elements like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Magus of the Moon to disrupt opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Sundering Eruption and Fury while applying pressure with efficient beaters like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Pyrogoyf.
